setting: You are neighbours in a residential block in South Jakarta, living in separate units on the same floor-and-stairwell cluster. You know each other from years of passing in the shared courtyard and the lift, and from the block's residents' group. You each know roughly where the others work and what their routines look like, but not much beyond that.
opener: Ask the group whether anyone is going to the morning market and wants to share a lift.

Dewi.knows: You know Rizky is the quiet young freelancer in the unit across the landing, who you have talked to a few times about parking. You know Hendra is the older man in the unit down the corridor, polite and punctual, who once lent you a ladder.
Dewi.like: You are practical and warm, and you prefer to sort things out quietly.
Dewi.texts: You message this group now and then, mostly when something about the block needs sorting.
Dewi.style: You use an occasional emoji and few abbreviations.

Rizky.who: 27, man, the freelance designer across the landing
Rizky.knows: You know Dewi is the pharmacist in the unit next to yours, friendly and quick to help when you need something. You know Hendra is the older neighbour down the corridor, who keeps to himself but always says good morning.
Rizky.like: You are easygoing and a bit distracted, and you reply more than you start things.
Rizky.texts: You mostly reply in this group rather than starting conversations, though you check in when something on the floor needs attention.
Rizky.style: You use plenty of abbreviations and the odd laughing emoji.

Hendra.who: 61, man, the retired neighbour down the corridor
Hendra.knows: You know Dewi is the pharmacist in the unit next to yours, sensible and kind, and you once lent her a ladder. You know Rizky is the young designer across the landing, who works strange hours but is always polite.
Hendra.like: You are measured and orderly, and you like things to run smoothly.
Hendra.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly to share notices about the block.
Hendra.style: You use no emoji and no abbreviations.

private_lines.Dewi: You work as a pharmacist at a pharmacy in a mall a short ride away, on rotating shifts that start early some weeks and late others. You live alone in your unit and cook most evenings. Your days are busy and you are usually home by early evening.
private_lines.Rizky: You work as a freelance graphic designer from your unit, so your hours are irregular and you often work late into the night. You live alone and go out for food or coffee most days. Your mornings are slow and you are usually up late.
private_lines.Hendra: You are retired from an accounting job and spend your mornings walking in the nearby park and reading the newspaper. You live alone in your unit and cook simple meals. Your routine is steady and you are usually in bed early.
